note.zh: 理解 LLM 是什么、能做什么、不能做什么。已有 NLP 基础可以直接跳到下一阶段。
note.en: Understand what an LLM is, what it can and cannot do. Skip ahead if you already have NLP basics.

note.zh: 先不用框架，亲手写一个 agent 循环。这一阶段结束时应能解释 workflow 与 agent 的区别，并有一个能调用工具的小程序。
note.en: Write an agent loop by hand before touching any framework. By the end you can explain workflows versus agents and have a small tool-using program.

note.zh: 协议、记忆、检索与编排框架。这是把玩具 agent 变成能处理真实任务的 agent 的三块积木。
note.en: Protocols, memory, retrieval and orchestration frameworks: the three blocks that turn a toy agent into one that handles real tasks.

note.zh: 失败模式、评估、可观测性与安全。大多数 agent 项目的差距不在能力，而在这里。
note.en: Failure modes, evaluation, observability and security. Most agent projects fall short here, not on capability.

weeks.zh: 第 12 到 14 周（求职路线）

note.zh: 把 agent 包成服务并部署。科研路线可以只读每个模块的「了解」层。
note.en: Package the agent as a service and deploy it. Research-track readers can stop at the intro tier of each module.

note.zh: 四个当前最活跃的方向，每个都附关键论文、基准、代码库和开放问题。求职路线选一个自己最感兴趣的深入即可。
note.en: Four of the most active directions, each with key papers, benchmarks, codebases and open problems. Industry-track readers can pick one.

note.zh: 项目模板、科研入门方法、求职准备与社区。学习地图的终点是一个你自己的项目，而不是读完的清单。
note.en: Project templates, how to start research, job preparation and community. The roadmap ends with a project of your own, not a finished reading list.

why.zh: Agent 的每个能力都建立在 LLM 的行为特性之上：上下文窗口、采样、指令遵循、幻觉。不需要会训练模型，但需要知道它为什么会犯错。
why.en: Every agent capability rests on how LLMs behave: context windows, sampling, instruction following, hallucination. You do not need to train models, but you need to know why they fail.

concepts.zh: token、上下文窗口、温度与采样
concepts.en: Tokens, context window, temperature and sampling

concepts.zh: 预训练、SFT、RLHF 三个阶段各自带来什么
concepts.en: What pretraining, SFT and RLHF each contribute

concepts.zh: 提示工程的基本技巧：示例、结构化、角色、思维链
concepts.en: Prompting basics: examples, structure, roles, chain of thought

concepts.zh: 幻觉与知识截止的成因
concepts.en: Where hallucination and knowledge cutoffs come from

questions.zh: 为什么同一个提示两次输出不同？
questions.en: Why does the same prompt give different outputs?

questions.zh: 上下文窗口填满后会发生什么？
questions.en: What happens when the context window fills up?

questions.zh: RLHF 解决了什么，没解决什么？
questions.en: What does RLHF solve, and what does it not?

task.zh: 用任意一家 API 写 50 行代码：读入一段文本，让模型输出结构化 JSON 摘要，并统计 token 与费用。
task.en: Write 50 lines against any API: read a text, have the model return a structured JSON summary, and log tokens and cost.

why.zh: 中文社区已有成体系的开源教程（Datawhale 系列、李宏毅课程）和国产模型的官方 agent 文档。以中文为母语的读者可以从这里起步，再进入英文一手资料。
why.en: The Chinese community has systematic open tutorials (Datawhale series, Hung-yi Lee's course) and official agent docs for Chinese models. Native readers can start here and move to English primary sources.

concepts.zh: hello-agents 的章节结构对应本地图的前三个阶段
concepts.en: hello-agents' chapters map onto the first three stages of this roadmap

concepts.zh: Qwen-Agent、MS-Agent 等国产框架与 LangGraph 的对应关系
concepts.en: How Qwen-Agent and MS-Agent relate to LangGraph

concepts.zh: 国产模型 API 与 OpenAI 兼容接口
concepts.en: Chinese model APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints

questions.zh: 中文教程与英文官方文档说法不一致时以谁为准？
questions.en: When a Chinese tutorial and the English docs disagree, which wins?

task.zh: 跟完 hello-agents 前四章，把它的示例改成调用国产模型 API。
task.en: Finish the first four chapters of hello-agents and port its example to a Chinese model API.

why.zh: 一个 agent 循环只有几十行：调用模型、解析工具调用、执行、把结果放回上下文、重复。先手写一遍，之后所有框架都只是这个循环的封装。
why.en: An agent loop is a few dozen lines: call the model, parse tool calls, execute, append results, repeat. Write it once by hand; every framework afterwards is a wrapper around this loop.

concepts.zh: 思考、行动、观察的循环
concepts.en: The think, act, observe loop

concepts.zh: 停止条件与最大轮数
concepts.en: Stop conditions and maximum turns

concepts.zh: 工具结果如何回到上下文
concepts.en: How tool results re-enter the context

concepts.zh: workflow 与 agent 的分界
concepts.en: Where a workflow ends and an agent begins

questions.zh: 你的 agent 什么时候停？
questions.en: When does your agent stop?

questions.zh: 如果工具抛异常，循环怎么处理？
questions.en: What does the loop do when a tool throws?

questions.zh: 哪些任务用固定流程比 agent 更好？
questions.en: Which tasks are better served by a fixed pipeline?

task.zh: 不用任何框架，写一个能读写文件、运行 shell 命令的 agent，让它修一个你故意埋的 bug。
task.en: Without a framework, write an agent that reads and writes files and runs shell commands; have it fix a bug you planted.

why.zh: 路由、并行、编排者与执行者、评估者与优化者、反思。掌握这几个模式就能读懂大多数论文和产品的架构图，也能判断一个系统是否过度设计。
why.en: Routing, parallelisation, orchestrator-worker, evaluator-optimiser, reflection. With these you can read most architecture diagrams in papers and products and spot over-engineering.

concepts.zh: Anthropic 的 workflow 与 agent 分类
concepts.en: Anthropic's workflow versus agent taxonomy

concepts.zh: ReAct、plan-and-execute、reflection 各自适合什么
concepts.en: When ReAct, plan-and-execute and reflection each fit

concepts.zh: 上下文工程：上下文是稀缺资源
concepts.en: Context engineering: context as a scarce resource

concepts.zh: 工具描述的写法影响 agent 表现
concepts.en: Tool descriptions shape agent behaviour

questions.zh: 编排者与执行者模式的代价是什么？
questions.en: What does the orchestrator-worker pattern cost?

questions.zh: 反思什么时候有用，什么时候只是多花钱？
questions.en: When does reflection help, and when does it just cost more?

questions.zh: 如何压缩一个长对话的上下文？
questions.en: How would you compact a long conversation's context?

task.zh: 把你的手写 agent 改成两种模式（路由 + 评估者优化者），在同一组 10 个任务上比较成本和成功率。
task.en: Refactor your hand-written agent into two patterns (routing plus evaluator-optimiser) and compare cost and success on the same 10 tasks.

title.zh: 工具调用与结构化输出

why.zh: 工具调用是 agent 与世界交互的接口，结构化输出是让程序可靠消费模型结果的手段。两者都依赖 JSON Schema，也都会失败，失败后的处理决定系统的稳定性。
why.en: Tool calling is the agent's interface to the world; structured output lets programs consume model results reliably. Both rely on JSON Schema, both fail, and the handling of failure decides stability.

concepts.zh: JSON Schema：required、enum、additionalProperties
concepts.en: JSON Schema: required, enum, additionalProperties

concepts.zh: tool_call 到 tool_result 的消息流
concepts.en: The tool_call to tool_result message flow

concepts.zh: Pydantic 校验与失败重试
concepts.en: Pydantic validation and retry on failure

concepts.zh: 并行工具调用的安全性
concepts.en: When parallel tool calls are safe

questions.zh: 模型返回了 schema 之外的字段怎么办？
questions.en: The model returns a field outside the schema: what now?

questions.zh: 工具描述里最重要的一句话是什么？
questions.en: What is the single most important sentence in a tool description?

task.zh: 给 agent 加三个工具，用 Pydantic 定义输入输出，故意让模型产生非法参数并实现校验后重试。
task.en: Add three tools with Pydantic-typed inputs and outputs; provoke invalid arguments and implement validate-then-retry.

why.zh: MCP 把「模型如何接入工具与数据」标准化，已成为事实标准；A2A 则处理 agent 之间的互操作。理解协议层能让你的 agent 接入现有生态，而不是重复造轮子。
why.en: MCP standardises how models connect to tools and data and has become the de facto standard; A2A handles agent-to-agent interoperability. Knowing the protocol layer lets your agent plug into an ecosystem instead of rebuilding it.

concepts.zh: host、client、server 三方关系
concepts.en: Host, client and server roles

concepts.zh: tools、resources、prompts 三类原语
concepts.en: The three primitives: tools, resources, prompts

concepts.zh: stdio 与 streamable HTTP 传输
concepts.en: stdio versus streamable HTTP transports

concepts.zh: 安全边界：server 不可信、工具投毒
concepts.en: Trust boundaries: untrusted servers, tool poisoning

questions.zh: MCP 解决了普通 function calling 解决不了的什么问题？
questions.en: What does MCP solve that plain function calling cannot?

questions.zh: 延迟敏感的工具要不要放在 MCP 后面？
questions.en: Would you put a latency-critical tool behind MCP?

task.zh: 用官方 Python SDK 写一个 MCP server，暴露一个工具和一个资源，用 Inspector 调通后从你的 agent 里调用。
task.en: Write an MCP server with the official Python SDK exposing one tool and one resource; test it in the Inspector, then call it from your agent.

why.zh: 上下文窗口有限，agent 需要在窗口之外存东西：跨会话的长期记忆、按需检索的知识。记忆的设计决定了 agent 是否能从经验中改进。
why.en: Context windows are finite, so agents need storage beyond them: long-term memory across sessions and knowledge retrieved on demand. Memory design decides whether an agent improves from experience.

concepts.zh: 短期（线程内）与长期（跨会话）记忆
concepts.en: Short-term (thread) versus long-term (cross-session) memory

concepts.zh: 语义、情景、程序性记忆
concepts.en: Semantic, episodic and procedural memory

concepts.zh: chunking、混合检索、重排序、contextual retrieval
concepts.en: Chunking, hybrid search, reranking, contextual retrieval

concepts.zh: 记忆写入的时机与冲突处理
concepts.en: When to write memory and how to resolve conflicts

questions.zh: 什么该进系统提示，什么该进检索？
questions.en: What belongs in the system prompt versus retrieval?

questions.zh: 记忆里的错误信息怎么被发现和纠正？
questions.en: How does wrong information in memory get caught and corrected?

task.zh: 给 agent 加一个跨会话的用户档案存储和一个文档检索工具；检索内容只进 tool_result，不进系统提示。
task.en: Add a cross-session user profile store and a document retrieval tool; retrieved content goes only into tool_result, never the system prompt.

why.zh: LangGraph、OpenAI Agents SDK、Pydantic AI、Google ADK 各有取舍。框架带来持久化、人在回路、递归上限等能力，也带来抽象泄漏。手写过循环之后再学框架，才知道它替你做了什么。
why.en: LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI and Google ADK make different trade-offs. Frameworks add persistence, human-in-the-loop and recursion limits, and also leak abstractions. Learn them after writing the loop yourself so you know what they do for you.

concepts.zh: state、node、edge、checkpoint、interrupt
concepts.en: State, node, edge, checkpoint, interrupt

concepts.zh: handoff 与 guardrail 原语
concepts.en: Handoff and guardrail primitives

concepts.zh: 声明式与命令式编排
concepts.en: Declarative versus imperative orchestration

concepts.zh: 选型标准：对上下文的控制力
concepts.en: Selection criterion: how much control over context you keep

questions.zh: 你会把手写 agent 迁到框架上吗？得到什么，失去什么？
questions.en: Would you move your hand-written agent to a framework? What do you gain and lose?

questions.zh: 持久化状态对长任务意味着什么？
questions.en: What does persisted state mean for long-running tasks?

task.zh: 用 LangGraph 或 OpenAI Agents SDK 重写你的 agent，加上人在回路的确认节点，写 10 行对比笔记。
task.en: Rewrite your agent in LangGraph or the OpenAI Agents SDK with a human-in-the-loop approval node; write ten lines of comparison notes.

why.zh: Agent 失败有规律：规格不清、工具循环、上下文污染、agent 之间错位、验证缺失。掌握分类学，才能从一次失败推广到一类修复。
why.en: Agent failures follow patterns: unclear specification, tool loops, context poisoning, inter-agent misalignment, missing verification. A taxonomy lets you generalise one failure into a class of fixes.

concepts.zh: MAST 的 14 类失败与三大类别
concepts.en: MAST's 14 failure modes in three categories

concepts.zh: max_turns 与 recursion_limit
concepts.en: max_turns and recursion_limit

concepts.zh: 上下文失效：poisoning、distraction、confusion、clash
concepts.en: Context failure: poisoning, distraction, confusion, clash

concepts.zh: 失败日志的最小字段集
concepts.en: The minimum fields a failure log needs

questions.zh: 怎么发现一个正在死循环的 agent？
questions.en: How do you detect an agent that is looping?

questions.zh: 上一次失败是哪一类？防护加在哪一层？
questions.en: Which class was your last failure, and at which layer did you add the guard?

task.zh: 对照 MAST 给你的 agent 写一张表：每类失败是「发生过 / 有防护 / 无防护」。
task.en: Against MAST, tabulate for your agent whether each failure class has occurred, is guarded, or is unguarded.

why.zh: 没有评估就没有迭代。工业界靠 golden dataset、自动打分和 LLM judge 的校准；研究界靠基准和可复现的协议。两边的共同点是先做错误分析，再决定量什么。
why.en: No evaluation, no iteration. Industry relies on golden datasets, automated scorers and calibrated LLM judges; research relies on benchmarks and reproducible protocols. Both start with error analysis before deciding what to measure.

concepts.zh: 三层评估：断言、LLM judge、人工标注
concepts.en: Three tiers: assertions, LLM judge, human labels

concepts.zh: judge 的位置、冗长、自我偏好偏差
concepts.en: Judge biases: position, verbosity, self-preference

concepts.zh: 轨迹评估与结果评估，pass@k 与 pass^k
concepts.en: Trajectory versus outcome evals, pass@k versus pass^k

concepts.zh: 离线回归与在线 A/B 的衔接
concepts.en: Connecting offline regression to online A/B

questions.zh: 怎么知道新提示比旧提示好？
questions.en: How do you know a new prompt beats the old one?

questions.zh: 怎么验证你的 LLM judge？
questions.en: How do you validate your LLM judge?

questions.zh: 一个 agent 基准的分数能说明什么，不能说明什么？
questions.en: What does a benchmark score tell you, and what does it not?

task.zh: 建 30 条 golden 任务，写三个自动 scorer，跑一次基线并记录；之后每次改动都重跑。
task.en: Build 30 golden tasks and three automated scorers; record a baseline and rerun after every change.

why.zh: trace 是 agent 的显微镜。没有 trace，你只能靠猜；有了 trace，延迟、成本、路由决策和失败点都可以被定位。这也是求职时最容易展示工程成熟度的地方。
why.en: Traces are the microscope for agents. Without them you guess; with them latency, cost, routing decisions and failure points become locatable. It is also the easiest place to show engineering maturity in interviews.

concepts.zh: trace、span、attribute、event
concepts.en: Trace, span, attribute, event

concepts.zh: Langfuse、LangSmith、Phoenix 与 OTel 的关系
concepts.en: How Langfuse, LangSmith and Phoenix relate to OpenTelemetry

concepts.zh: OTel GenAI 语义约定
concepts.en: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions

concepts.zh: 四个黄金信号与 cost per conversation
concepts.en: The four golden signals and cost per conversation

questions.zh: 一次对话在 trace 里长什么样？
questions.en: What does one conversation look like as a trace?

questions.zh: 怎么把成本归到会话？
questions.en: How do you attribute cost to a session?

task.zh: 给 agent 接 Langfuse 或 Phoenix，每个模型和工具调用一个 span，找出最慢和最贵的一次调用。
task.en: Instrument the agent with Langfuse or Phoenix, one span per model and tool call; find the slowest and the most expensive call.

why.zh: 能调工具的 agent 会读到不可信内容，prompt injection 因此从理论风险变成日常问题。安全不是过滤器，而是权限设计：私有数据、不可信内容、外发通道三者不能同时存在。
why.en: A tool-using agent reads untrusted content, so prompt injection moves from theory to daily practice. Security is not a filter but a permission design: private data, untrusted content and an exfiltration channel must never coexist.

concepts.zh: prompt injection 与 lethal trifecta
concepts.en: Prompt injection and the lethal trifecta

concepts.zh: OWASP LLM Top 10 与 agentic 威胁
concepts.en: OWASP LLM Top 10 and agentic threats

concepts.zh: 最小权限、沙箱、人工确认
concepts.en: Least privilege, sandboxes, human approval

concepts.zh: 红队测试与 AgentDojo 类基准
concepts.en: Red-teaming and AgentDojo-style benchmarks

questions.zh: 你的 agent 读到「忽略之前的指令」会发生什么？
questions.en: What happens when your agent reads 'ignore previous instructions'?

questions.zh: 哪个工具的权限最应该被收窄？
questions.en: Which tool's permissions most need narrowing?

task.zh: 在你的 agent 检索的文档里埋一段注入指令，观察行为，然后用权限设计而不是提示词修复它。
task.en: Plant an injected instruction in a document your agent retrieves, observe, then fix it with permission design rather than prompt wording.

why.zh: 研究代码是脚本，产品代码是服务。把 agent 包成 HTTP 服务需要 FastAPI、async 并发模型和流式响应。
why.en: Research code is scripts; product code is services. Wrapping an agent as an HTTP service needs FastAPI, the async concurrency model and streaming responses.

concepts.zh: HTTP 方法、状态码、幂等性
concepts.en: HTTP methods, status codes, idempotency

concepts.zh: FastAPI 路由、依赖注入、Pydantic 校验
concepts.en: FastAPI routing, dependency injection, Pydantic validation

concepts.zh: asyncio：什么会阻塞事件循环
concepts.en: asyncio: what blocks the event loop

concepts.zh: SSE 与 WebSocket 流式输出
concepts.en: Streaming with SSE and WebSockets

questions.zh: LLM 服务为什么用 async？
questions.en: Why async for an LLM service?

questions.zh: 设计开启会话、发送回合、流式返回的三个接口。
questions.en: Design the three endpoints: open session, send turn, stream reply.

task.zh: 把 agent 包成 FastAPI 服务，回合接口用 SSE 流式返回，写 pytest 把模型调用 mock 掉。
task.en: Wrap the agent in FastAPI with an SSE-streaming turn endpoint; write pytest with the model call mocked.

why.zh: 能在别人的机器上跑起来才叫产品。Docker、云上的无服务器容器、CI/CD 和密钥管理是最小集合。
why.en: It is a product only when it runs on someone else's machine. Docker, serverless containers, CI/CD and secret management are the minimum set.

concepts.zh: Dockerfile、多阶段构建、层缓存
concepts.en: Dockerfile, multi-stage builds, layer caching

concepts.zh: Cloud Run 类平台的冷启动与并发
concepts.en: Cold starts and concurrency on Cloud Run-style platforms

concepts.zh: 密钥不进代码
concepts.en: Secrets never in code

concepts.zh: GitHub Actions 自动测试与部署
concepts.en: GitHub Actions for tests and deploys

questions.zh: 第一个请求为什么慢三秒？
questions.en: Why is the first request three seconds slow?

questions.zh: API key 放在哪里？
questions.en: Where do the API keys live?

task.zh: 容器化 agent 服务并部署到任意云，push 到 main 自动跑测试并部署。
task.en: Containerise the agent service, deploy to any cloud, and auto-test-and-deploy on push to main.

why.zh: 生产 agent 的三个硬指标：首 token 延迟、每次对话成本、供应商故障时的表现。缓存、路由、退避与 fallback 是标准手段。
why.en: Three hard numbers for production agents: time to first token, cost per conversation, behaviour when a provider fails. Caching, routing, backoff and fallbacks are the standard tools.

concepts.zh: TTFT、流式、prompt caching
concepts.en: TTFT, streaming, prompt caching

concepts.zh: 小模型路由到大模型
concepts.en: Routing easy requests to smaller models

concepts.zh: 指数退避、熔断、供应商 fallback
concepts.en: Exponential backoff, circuit breakers, provider fallbacks

concepts.zh: 按会话归集成本
concepts.en: Attributing cost per conversation

questions.zh: 供应商高峰期返回 429，你的服务做什么？
questions.en: The provider returns 429 at peak: what does your service do?

questions.zh: 成本减半而质量不降，从哪里下手？
questions.en: Halve cost without losing quality: where do you start?

task.zh: 加 prompt caching、小模型路由和 fallback，对比改造前后的 TTFT 与每次对话成本。
task.en: Add prompt caching, small-model routing and a fallback; compare TTFT and cost per conversation before and after.

why.zh: 语音和视频 agent 把延迟预算压到一秒以内，需要流式 STT、LLM、TTS 的级联或端到端语音模型。了解即可，除非目标岗位是实时系统。
why.en: Voice and video agents squeeze the latency budget under a second, using cascaded streaming STT, LLM and TTS or end-to-end speech models. Awareness is enough unless the target role is realtime systems.

concepts.zh: 级联管道与 speech-to-speech 的取舍
concepts.en: Cascaded pipelines versus speech-to-speech

concepts.zh: 语音回合的延迟预算拆分
concepts.en: Breaking down a voice turn's latency budget

concepts.zh: WebRTC 与 WebSocket 的角色
concepts.en: Roles of WebRTC and WebSockets

questions.zh: 一个语音回合的延迟花在哪里？
questions.en: Where does the latency go in one voice turn?

task.zh: 用 Pipecat 或 LiveKit 跑一个本地语音 demo，测一次端到端延迟并拆分到各阶段。
task.en: Run a local voice demo with Pipecat or LiveKit; measure end-to-end latency and split it by stage.

why.zh: DeepSeek-R1 之后，用可验证奖励的强化学习训练模型「学会使用工具和多轮行动」成为最热的研究线。它把 agent 从提示工程推向训练问题，也是研究入门的最佳切口之一。
why.en: Since DeepSeek-R1, training models to use tools and act over multiple turns with verifiable-reward RL has become the hottest research line. It moves agents from prompt engineering to a training problem and is one of the best entry points for research.

concepts.zh: PPO、GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 的关系
concepts.en: How PPO, GRPO, DAPO and GSPO relate

concepts.zh: 可验证奖励与奖励设计
concepts.en: Verifiable rewards and reward design

concepts.zh: 多轮工具调用的 rollout 与 token masking
concepts.en: Multi-turn tool rollouts and token masking

concepts.zh: 训练框架：verl、OpenRLHF、SkyRL、rLLM、Agent Lightning
concepts.en: Training frameworks: verl, OpenRLHF, SkyRL, rLLM, Agent Lightning

questions.zh: 为什么 SFT 教不会模型「什么时候」调用工具？
questions.en: Why can't SFT alone teach a model when to call a tool?

questions.zh: 奖励被 hack 时你会看到什么现象？
questions.en: What do you see when the reward gets hacked?

open.zh: 长时程任务的信用分配
环境与奖励的可扩展构建
open.en: Scalable construction of environments and rewards

open.zh: 训练后的泛化：新工具、新环境
open.en: Generalisation after training to new tools and environments

task.zh: 在单卡上用 TRL 或 Unsloth 跑一次 GRPO，奖励函数是「工具调用格式正确且结果正确」，画出奖励曲线。
task.en: Run GRPO on one GPU with TRL or Unsloth, rewarding correct tool-call format plus correct result; plot the reward curve.

why.zh: 编程是 agent 落地最成熟的领域：SWE-bench 定义了标准，Claude Code、Codex、OpenHands 等把它变成产品。读懂 100 行的 mini-swe-agent，就理解了这个领域的核心。
why.en: Coding is the most mature agent domain: SWE-bench set the standard and Claude Code, Codex and OpenHands turned it into products. Reading the 100-line mini-swe-agent gets you to the core of the field.

concepts.zh: agent-computer interface 的设计
concepts.en: Agent-computer interface design

concepts.zh: SWE-bench Verified、Pro 与 Terminal-Bench
concepts.en: SWE-bench Verified, Pro and Terminal-Bench

concepts.zh: 上下文管理：CLAUDE.md、子 agent、压缩
concepts.en: Context management: CLAUDE.md, subagents, compaction

concepts.zh: 训练数据合成：SWE-Gym、SWE-smith
concepts.en: Training data synthesis: SWE-Gym, SWE-smith

questions.zh: 为什么接口设计比模型大小对成绩影响更大？
questions.en: Why does interface design move the score more than model size?

questions.zh: 长任务里 agent 最常在哪一步失败？
questions.en: Where do agents most often fail in long tasks?

open.zh: 跨仓库、长时程的软件工程任务
基准污染与真实生产力的差距

task.zh: 读完 mini-swe-agent 源码，在 SWE-bench Lite 的 20 个实例上跑通并分析失败原因。
task.en: Read mini-swe-agent end to end, run it on 20 SWE-bench Lite instances and analyse the failures.

why.zh: 让 agent 直接操作屏幕、浏览器和手机，是通向通用助理的路径。OSWorld、WebArena 等基准显示成功率仍然很低，因此既是产品热点也是研究缺口。
why.en: Letting agents operate screens, browsers and phones is the path to general assistants. Benchmarks such as OSWorld and WebArena show success rates are still low, so it is both a product hotspot and a research gap.

concepts.zh: 截图驱动与无障碍树驱动两条路线
concepts.en: Screenshot-driven versus accessibility-tree approaches

concepts.zh: grounding：从指令到坐标
concepts.en: Grounding: from instruction to coordinates

concepts.zh: 原生 GUI 模型（UI-TARS）与模块化框架（Agent S）
concepts.en: Native GUI models (UI-TARS) versus modular frameworks (Agent S)

concepts.zh: 安全：不可逆动作与确认
concepts.en: Safety: irreversible actions and confirmation

questions.zh: 为什么网页 agent 在真实网站上远比在沙箱里差？
questions.en: Why do web agents do far worse on real sites than in sandboxes?

questions.zh: 什么动作必须要人确认？
questions.en: Which actions must require human confirmation?

open.en: Long-horizon tasks with hundreds of steps

task.zh: 用 browser-use 或 Playwright MCP 写一个能完成三步网页任务的 agent，记录每一步的截图和决策。
task.en: With browser-use or Playwright MCP, build an agent that completes a three-step web task; log screenshot and decision per step.

why.zh: 多 agent 系统在研究里热、在生产里争议大：Anthropic 的研究系统证明它有用，Cognition 的文章提醒它容易失败。MAST 给出了失败分类，MCP 与 A2A 给出了互操作协议。
why.en: Multi-agent systems are hot in research and contested in production: Anthropic's research system shows they work, Cognition's essay shows how they fail. MAST classifies the failures; MCP and A2A provide interoperability.

concepts.zh: 编排者与子 agent 的上下文分配
concepts.en: Context allocation between orchestrator and subagents

concepts.zh: 何时不该用多 agent
concepts.en: When not to use multiple agents

concepts.zh: MCP（agent 到工具）与 A2A（agent 到 agent）
concepts.en: MCP (agent to tool) versus A2A (agent to agent)

concepts.zh: MAST 的三大失败类别
concepts.en: MAST's three failure categories

questions.zh: 两个 agent 共享多少上下文才够？
questions.en: How much context must two agents share?

questions.zh: 什么任务真的需要并行 agent？
questions.en: Which tasks truly need parallel agents?

open.zh: 多 agent 的信用分配与联合训练
open.en: Credit assignment and joint training for multi-agent systems

open.zh: 跨组织 agent 的信任与身份
open.en: Trust and identity for agents across organisations

task.zh: 把你的 agent 拆成编排者加两个子 agent，在同一任务集上和单 agent 对比成本与成功率，并用 MAST 标注失败。
task.en: Split your agent into an orchestrator plus two subagents; compare cost and success with the single agent on the same tasks and label failures with MAST.

why.zh: Agent 会自主行动，因此「它为什么这么做」从学术问题变成审计需求。推理链不一定忠实，监控它是一个脆弱但宝贵的机会；trace 与审计记录是工程侧的对应物。
why.en: Agents act autonomously, so 'why did it do that' turns from an academic question into an audit requirement. Reasoning traces are not always faithful; monitoring them is a fragile but valuable opportunity, and traces plus audit logs are the engineering counterpart.

concepts.zh: 思维链忠实性与可监控性
concepts.en: Chain-of-thought faithfulness and monitorability

concepts.zh: agentic misalignment 与 sabotage 评估
concepts.en: Agentic misalignment and sabotage evaluations

concepts.zh: 机制可解释性入门：TransformerLens、attribution graphs
concepts.en: Mechanistic interpretability basics: TransformerLens, attribution graphs

concepts.zh: 审计记录：OTel GenAI 约定、AgentOps
concepts.en: Audit trails: OTel GenAI conventions, AgentOps

questions.zh: 模型说的理由和真实原因不一致时，审计还能依赖什么？
questions.en: When the stated reason differs from the real cause, what can an audit still rely on?

questions.zh: 哪些 agent 行为必须留下不可篡改的记录？
questions.en: Which agent actions must leave tamper-proof records?

open.zh: 面向 agent 的可解释性方法
监控推理链的长期有效性
法规对可解释性的具体要求（EU AI Act）
open.en: Concrete regulatory requirements for explainability (EU AI Act)

task.zh: 给你的 agent 设计一份审计记录格式，能回答「谁在何时因为什么证据做了什么」，并用一次真实运行填满它。
task.en: Design an audit-record format for your agent that answers who did what, when, on what evidence; fill it from one real run.

why.zh: 最好的学习是改一个能跑的东西。这里是官方快速启动、开源 deep research、语音 agent 和课程结课项目，每个都能在一天内跑起来。
why.en: The best learning is modifying something that runs. Here are official quickstarts, open deep-research agents, voice agents and course capstones, each runnable within a day.

concepts.zh: 先跑通再改动
concepts.en: Run it first, then change it

concepts.zh: 每个项目至少加一个评估
concepts.en: Every project gets at least one evaluation

concepts.zh: 写一篇复盘博客
concepts.en: Write a retrospective post

questions.zh: 你改动了什么，指标变了多少？
questions.en: What did you change, and how much did the metric move?

task.zh: 从下方项目阶梯选一个，两周内交付并公开。
task.en: Pick one rung from the project ladder below; deliver and publish it within two weeks.

why.zh: Agent 研究进展快、噪音大。读论文的方法、选题的判断、复现的习惯和写作的训练，比任何一篇具体论文都更持久。
why.en: Agent research moves fast and is noisy. Methods for reading, judgement in choosing problems, the habit of reproduction and training in writing outlast any single paper.

concepts.zh: 三遍读论文法
concepts.en: The three-pass paper reading method

concepts.zh: 目标驱动与问题驱动的研究
concepts.en: Goal-driven versus problem-driven research

concepts.zh: 复现一篇论文作为入门仪式
concepts.en: Reproducing a paper as the rite of passage

concepts.zh: 会议与投稿节奏：NeurIPS、ICLR、ICML、ACL、COLM
concepts.en: Venues and cycles: NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACL, COLM

questions.zh: 这篇论文的主张靠哪一个实验支撑？
questions.en: Which single experiment carries this paper's claim?

questions.zh: 如果结果不可复现，你的下一步是什么？
questions.en: If the result does not reproduce, what is your next step?

task.zh: 复现 ReAct 在 HotpotQA 上的结果，写一页复现报告，包括与原文的差异。
task.en: Reproduce ReAct on HotpotQA and write a one-page report including deviations from the original.

why.zh: Agent 工程师岗位看三样：一个能打开的项目、讲清楚故障与修复的能力、以及 LLM 应用的系统设计。刷题是次要的。
why.en: Agent engineering roles look for three things: a project one can open, the ability to explain a failure and its fix, and system design for LLM applications. Algorithm drills are secondary.

concepts.zh: AI Engineer 岗位画像
concepts.en: The AI Engineer role profile

concepts.zh: STAR 故事库：至少三个来自自己的项目
concepts.en: A STAR story bank with at least three from your own projects

concepts.zh: LLM 应用系统设计的答题框架
concepts.en: A framework for LLM system design questions

concepts.zh: 公开写作作为作品集
concepts.en: Public writing as portfolio

questions.zh: 你的项目在生产里出过什么故障，怎么发现的？
questions.en: What broke in your project, and how did you find it?

questions.zh: 设计一个带评估与追踪的 agent 服务。
questions.en: Design an agent service with evaluation and tracing.

task.zh: 为你的项目写一篇「故障、诊断、度量」的博客，并准备一个 10 分钟的系统设计白板答案。
task.en: Write a failure-diagnosis-measurement post about your project and prepare a 10-minute system-design whiteboard answer.

why.zh: 这个领域每月都有新东西。固定两三个高信噪比的信息源，比订阅二十个更有效。
why.en: Something new lands every month. Two or three high-signal sources beat twenty subscriptions.

concepts.zh: 一手来源优先：实验室博客、论文、代码
concepts.en: Primary sources first: lab blogs, papers, code

concepts.zh: 每周固定一小时的跟进节奏
concepts.en: A fixed weekly hour for catching up

questions.zh: 上个月最重要的一篇文章是什么，为什么？
questions.en: What was the most important piece last month, and why?

task.zh: 选三个信息源，连续四周每周写三句话的跟进笔记。
task.en: Pick three sources and write three-sentence notes weekly for four weeks.

title.en: The big picture and open problems

why.zh: 读几篇高质量的总览，再看课程与 METR 这类评测机构的报告，能帮你判断哪些方向是趋势、哪些是噪音。
why.en: A few high-quality overviews, plus university courses and reports from evaluators such as METR, help you separate trends from noise.

concepts.zh: Software 3.0 与部分自治
concepts.en: Software 3.0 and partial autonomy

concepts.zh: 任务时程作为能力指标
concepts.en: Task horizon as a capability metric

concepts.zh: 长时程部署的真实失败（Project Vend）
concepts.en: Real failures of long-horizon deployment (Project Vend)

questions.zh: 你认为未来两年 agent 领域最可能被解决的问题是什么？
questions.en: Which agent problem do you expect to be solved within two years?

task.zh: 写一页你自己的「agent 领域地图」，和本页的地图比较差异。
task.en: Write your own one-page map of the agent field and compare it with the one on this page.

intro.zh: 把 agent 领域看成五层：底层是模型能力，中间是单个 agent 的核心机制，再往上是多 agent 与协议，顶层是应用领域，旁边贯穿的是保障层。点击节点跳到对应模块。
intro.en: Think of the field as five layers: model capability at the bottom, the core mechanisms of a single agent above it, then multi-agent systems and protocols, application domains on top, with an assurance layer running alongside. Click a node to jump to its module.

label.zh: 原生 GUI 与工具模型

level.zh: 第 1 级 · 一个周末

desc.zh: 不用框架，写一个能读写文件和执行 shell 的 agent，让它修一个你埋的 bug。
desc.en: No framework: an agent that reads and writes files and runs shell commands; it fixes a bug you planted.

learn.zh: agent 循环、工具调用、停止条件
learn.en: The agent loop, tool calling, stop conditions

name.zh: 带记忆与检索的个人助理
name.en: Personal assistant with memory and retrieval

desc.zh: 接入你自己的笔记或文档，跨会话记住偏好，接一个 MCP server。
desc.en: Connect your own notes or documents, remember preferences across sessions, plug in one MCP server.

name.zh: 带评估与追踪的 deep research agent
name.en: Deep research agent with evals and tracing

desc.zh: 多步搜索与综述，30 条 golden 问题，三个自动 scorer，每次调用都有 trace。
desc.en: Multi-step search and synthesis, 30 golden questions, three automated scorers, a trace for every call.

learn.zh: 评估闭环、可观测性、失败分析
learn.en: The eval loop, observability, failure analysis

level.zh: 第 4 级 · 三周（求职）

desc.zh: FastAPI 流式接口、容器化、云部署、CI/CD、prompt caching 与 fallback、cost per conversation 看板。
desc.en: FastAPI streaming API, containerised, cloud deployed, CI/CD, prompt caching and fallbacks, a cost-per-conversation dashboard.

level.zh: 第 4 级 · 三周（科研）

name.zh: 复现并改进一个基准结果
name.en: Reproduce and improve a benchmark result

desc.zh: 在 SWE-bench Lite、WebArena 子集或 tau-bench 上复现一个开源 agent，做一处改动并做消融。
desc.en: Reproduce an open agent on SWE-bench Lite, a WebArena subset or tau-bench; make one change and run an ablation.

learn.zh: 基准协议、可复现性、消融

level.zh: 第 5 级 · 一到两个月

name.zh: 用 RL 训练一个小 agent
name.en: Train a small agent with RL

desc.zh: 单卡 GRPO 训练一个 1.5B 到 7B 模型学会多轮工具调用，报告奖励曲线、泛化测试与失败案例。
desc.en: Single-GPU GRPO training of a 1.5B to 7B model for multi-turn tool use; report reward curves, generalisation tests and failure cases.

learn.en: The agentic RL pipeline end to end

level.zh: 第 5 级 · 一到两个月

name.zh: 多 agent 系统与失败分析

desc.zh: 编排者加子 agent 完成一个复杂任务，用 MAST 标注 100 条 trace，提出并验证一项修复。
desc.en: An orchestrator plus subagents on a complex task; label 100 traces with MAST, propose and validate one fix.

learn.zh: 多 agent 设计、失败分类、实证研究
learn.en: Multi-agent design, failure taxonomy, empirical study

research_path.zh: 读三篇综述建立坐标系：Wang et al. 2023、CoALA、Agentic RL survey。
research_path.en: Read three surveys to build coordinates: Wang et al. 2023, CoALA, the agentic RL survey.

research_path.zh: 复现一篇经典（ReAct 或 Reflexion），写复现报告。
research_path.en: Reproduce one classic (ReAct or Reflexion) and write a reproduction report.

research_path.zh: 选一个基准，跑通一个开源 agent 的完整评估。
research_path.en: Pick a benchmark and run a full evaluation of one open agent.

research_path.zh: 从失败案例里找问题：读 100 条 trace 比读 100 篇论文更快找到选题。
research_path.en: Find problems in failures: reading 100 traces finds a topic faster than reading 100 papers.

research_path.zh: 做一处最小改动加消融，写成 4 页 workshop 论文投稿。
research_path.en: Make one minimal change with an ablation; write it as a 4-page workshop paper.

research_path.zh: 在 alphaXiv、HF Daily Papers 上跟进，每周固定时间。
research_path.en: Follow alphaXiv and HF Daily Papers at a fixed weekly time.

job.zh: 求职路线：以第 1 到 4 阶段和项目阶梯第 4 级（求职）为主，前沿方向选一个；重点是可打开的项目、评估与追踪、系统设计表达。
job.en: Industry track: focus on stages 1 to 4 and project rung 4 (industry); pick one frontier. What matters is an openable project, evals and tracing, and system-design articulation.

research.zh: 科研路线：第 1 到 3 阶段打底，第 4 阶段只看「了解」层，重心放在前沿方向、论文时间线、复现与项目阶梯第 5 级。
research.en: Research track: stages 1 to 3 as foundation, only the intro tier of stage 4, then the frontiers, the paper timeline, reproduction and project rung 5.

checklist.zh: 能不看资料手写一个带工具调用的 agent 循环
checklist.en: Can write a tool-calling agent loop from memory

checklist.zh: 能解释 workflow 与 agent 的区别并举出各自适用的任务
checklist.en: Can explain workflows versus agents with tasks that fit each

checklist.zh: 有一个公开的项目，附评估结果与 trace 截图
checklist.en: Have a public project with eval results and a trace screenshot

checklist.zh: 能讲一个自己项目的故障、诊断与度量
checklist.en: Can tell one failure, its diagnosis and its measurement from your own project

checklist.zh: 读过 MAST，能给自己的系统做失败分类
checklist.en: Have read MAST and can classify your own system's failures

checklist.zh: 能说出 MCP 与 A2A 分别解决什么
checklist.en: Can state what MCP and A2A each solve

checklist.zh: 跟进过近三个月至少五篇前沿工作
checklist.en: Have followed at least five frontier works from the last three months

checklist.zh: 选定了一个前沿方向并跑通了它的一个基准
checklist.en: Have chosen one frontier and run one of its benchmarks
